skill.name: notion-api
skill.description: Use Notion API scripts to search, read, create, update, and query Notion pages, databases, and blocks with a NOTION_TOKEN.
skill.summary: Search, read, and manage Notion workspace content through Bun scripts and the official Notion API.
skill.author: BLTGV

security_audit.summary: No prompt-injection text, malware behavior, obfuscated executable code, or unauthorized endpoints were found. Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, documentation examples, and TypeScript template literals. The confirmed risks are expected Notion API network access and use of the NOTION_TOKEN credential.

remediation.suggestion: Use a least-privilege Notion integration and share only the pages or databases required for the task.
Document that scripts call the official Notion API and may return workspace data visible to the integration.

remediation.issue: Unencoded Notion identifiers in URL paths
remediation.suggestion: Validate and encode page, database, and block IDs before appending them to API paths.
Advise agents to pass user values as arguments and avoid shell interpolation for titles, filters, and properties.

content.value_statement: Working with Notion through chat is slow when data lives in pages, databases, and blocks. This skill lets Claude, Codex, or Claude Code search, read, create, and update Notion content through the official API.
actual_capabilities: Search accessible Notion pages and databases by query or object type.
Retrieve page metadata, properties, URLs, archive status, icons, and covers.
Create Notion pages under a page or database parent.
Update page titles, icons, properties, and archive state.
Query databases with filters, sorting, result limits, and pagination metadata.
Read page or block children, including recursive nested block content.
limitations: Requires Bun and a NOTION_TOKEN environment variable.
Can access only pages and databases shared with the Notion integration.
Does not create, update, or delete page blocks.
Large recursive block reads can be limited by Notion rate limits.

use_cases.title: Find Workspace Knowledge
use_cases.description: Search Notion for project notes, policies, or databases and return concise matching results.

use_cases.title: Track Project Databases
use_cases.description: Query task or roadmap databases with filters and sort recent records for review.

use_cases.title: Maintain Operational Pages
use_cases.description: Create and update Notion pages for recurring work, status notes, and team records.

prompt_templates.title: Search Pages
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search across accessible workspace items.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Notion workspace for "quarterly planning". Show matching pages and databases with titles, URLs, and last edited dates.

prompt_templates.title: Read Page Content
prompt_templates.scenario: Read one page and summarize its blocks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the Notion page with ID PAGE_ID. Summarize the page and list open tasks from its blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Create Project Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a new page under a known parent page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Notion page under PARENT_PAGE_ID named "Project Brief". Include the setup reminder if authentication is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Query and Update Database
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced database workflow with query and update steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Query DATABASE_ID for tasks marked Done and sorted by last edited time. Then update PAGE_ID with a new Status value.

output_examples.input: Search Notion for launch notes and summarize the newest matching page.
output: Found three matching pages and one database.
The newest page is Launch Retro, last edited yesterday.
Key points include release status, open follow-ups, and owner names.

output_examples.input: Read the blocks from a project page and list action items.
output: The page contains headings, task items, and a decision log.
Open actions include finalizing copy, confirming dates, and assigning support coverage.

output_examples.input: Create a status page under my team workspace page.
output: Created the page and returned its title, URL, parent, and current archive status.
The integration must have access to the parent page before creation works.

best_practices: Share only required Notion pages and databases with the integration.
Use specific page, database, and block IDs when reading or updating content.
Review database property names before sending filters, sorts, or update properties.
anti_patterns: Do not use a workspace-wide integration token when a narrow integration is enough.
Do not paste private page IDs into shared prompts unless the user approved access.
Do not run recursive block reads on large pages without a clear reason.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects to the official Notion API using the NOTION_TOKEN environment variable.

faq.question: Can it access every page in my workspace?
faq.answer: No. It can access only pages and databases shared with the Notion integration.

faq.question: Can it create new Notion pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create pages under a shared page or database parent.

faq.question: Can it edit existing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update page titles, icons, properties, and archive state.

faq.question: Can it edit block content?
faq.answer: No. The included block script reads blocks but does not modify block content.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
